25:2: Speak to Bnei Yisroel and say to them,
when you come to the land
the land shall be at rest —
25:4: But the seventh year shall be a complete rest for the land,
you shall not plant your field
and you shall not prune your vineyard.
25:6: The [produce] of the rest of the land shall be for yourselves, for food,
for you, your servant and your maidservant,
for your hired hand and your resident sojourner
25:8: You shall count for yourself seven rests of years,
and it shall be for you, the days (period) of the seven rests of years,
25:9: You shall sound the shofor of crying on the tenth day of the seventh month.
shall this shofor-proclamation be made. throughout all your land.
25:23: The land shall not be sold in perpetuity,
for, you are [merely as] foreign residents and residents before Me.
25:29: If a man shall sell a residential home [that is] within a city surrounded by a wall,
the time allotted for its redemption shall be
until the end of one year after he sold it.
He has the days [of a full year] in which to redeem it.
25:31: The houses of open cities which are not surrounded by an encircling wall
shall be considered as a field of the land.
and it is released by the jubilee.
25:35: and his hand (assets) become shaky among you,
[so too] the foreign resident and the sojourner, [so] that he shall live with you.
25:39: If your brother becomes impoverished and is sold to you,
you must not work him like slaves.
25:43: You must not make him work to crush him
and you shall fear your God.
25:45: Also, from the children of the uncircumcised sojourners who reside with you from them you may purchase [slaves],
and from their families that live among you
that were born in your land.
[All these] shall be your permanent possession.
25:46: You shall will them as inheritance to your children after you as hereditary property;
you shall keep them in servitude permanently.
However regarding your brethren, Bnei Yisroel, man over his brother,
you must not make him work to crush him.
25:47: If an uncircumcised one or resident with you acquires means
while your brother becomes impoverished by him,
and is sold to an uncircumcised resident who resides with you
25:49: Either his father’s brother or the son of his father’s brother (cousin) shall redeem him
or the closest (other) family relative shall redeem him.
If he obtains sufficient means of his own he may be redeemed [on his own.]
25:53: As a hired hand [working] on a yearly basis shall he be considered with him;
he shall not make him work to crush him before your eyes.
26:1: You shall not make false idols for yourselves and graven images and memorial stones you shall not raise up for yourselves,
and a prostration stone you shall not set in your land
for I am Adonoy, your God.
26:2: You shall keep the days of My Shabbosos
and you shall (revere) the House of My Sanctuary,
